PartitionsHeader: Select a local partition to boot (Press F6 in Ventoy to load this menu):
TipDefault: 👉 Selection tip: For UEFI systems, select the ⭐ System (EFI) partition (FAT32) of the desired operating system. For legacy BIOS boot, select the Windows partition (C:).
TipEfi: ⭐ EFI System Partition selected: This is the RECOMMENDED selection for UEFI boot. Select the matching bootloader (Windows, Ubuntu, Debian, Arch etc.).
TipWindows: ⊞ Windows OS Partition selected: On UEFI systems, the actual bootloader resides on the FAT32 System (EFI) partition. For Legacy BIOS boot, choose 'Windows Legacy (BIOS / bootmgr)'.
TipRecovery: 🛠️ Recovery Partition selected: Contains Windows RE (Recovery Environment), not a standard operating system.
TipData: 💾 Data Partition selected: If no bootloader exists on this partition, boot will fail.
SetDefaultLabel: ⭐ Set as default boot option (set default)

JsonAutoBootTipHotkey: 👉 Hotkey actions (such as F4/F5/F2/Exit) trigger immediately at boot. Main menu timeout is disabled here.
